name: CAA: per-table ⚠⟳ built even when it shares table 0's slot
why: Removes the single-table guard in _artRefreshPerTableFailedButtons(). On a single-table page the page-wide ⚠⟳ falls back to table 0's run and the per-table one joins it there: two identical controls (org/live-bootleg.org 1).

name: Relationships: per-table ⚠⟳ built even when it shares table 0's slot
why: Same guard in _relRefreshPerTableFailedButtons(); the series page is single-table, so the twin appears beside #mb-rel-retry-failed.

name: the guard also fires on a multi-table page
why: Over-correction: dropping the per-table controls everywhere. per-table-failed-retry.spec.js asserts the partition on the multi-table release group.

name: _setTip() writes title while the engine has it stashed
why: Removes the stash branch: a control re-tipped under a resting pointer exposes its title, and the browser draws a native box over the card.
grep: pointer at rest exposes no native title

name: _setTip() stashes but leaves the visible card stale
why: The card would keep the old count until the pointer moves.

name: multi-date titles never reach the multi-date parser
why: Without the '/' branch every multi-date title is a near miss again, flagged red.

name: extra /DD days are not checked against the month
why: "1977‐04‐30/31" would pass as valid: only the first day was validated.

name: the shared-location form is not tried
why: "1989‐07‐04 / 1990‐04‐22: Venue, …" would fall through to the near miss.
